test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements.**

Some paints are cats.

All cats are dogs.

Some dogs are bananas.

**Conclusion I: **Some paints are dogs.

**Conclusion II:** Some cats are bananas.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c21311003983ac456bc7ed6a8adc524043d9f307e25af3dc5b1a097846959107.png] 

Conclusion I: Some paints are dogs → **True** (Since some paints
 are cats, and all cats are dogs, this implies that those part of paints which is cats will also dogs).

Conclusion II: Some cats are bananas → **False **(As, there is no definite relation given between cats and bananas, so some cats are bananas will possible only).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion (I) follows"**.
